method: Systematic amplitude sensitivity with Monte Carlo falsification; adversarial PCA/GP nuisance search; era×station×lunation grid; blind year hold-out

adversarial_gp.method: 2D binned elongation x time GP (Step 060-style bin means)

interpretation: Known systematics: to explain |eta|=4.06e-04 requires 0.53 cm; smallest ratio to a known systematic is 1.5x. Adversarial PCA (20 residual-ranked PCs): joint eta=-2.93e-04 (survival=True). Full-data GP absorbs 83% of cos(D) amplitude, but CV-GP overfit_ratio=1.42 and cosD survives CV-GP=False; AIC prefers gp_only; time-only GP cosD survival=True. Full-data absorption is overfitting, not a physical systematic. Interaction grid: 13/26 fitted cells have negative eta; blind 5-fold year cross-validation concatenated out-of-sample eta=-3.68e-04 (6.0σ; disjoint combination 8.0σ, 4/5 folds negative). Modeled known-systematic-only MC falsification remains below observed |eta|. Unmodeled or data-driven nuisances are additionally stress-tested above.
